poema.texto:
Title: Zéjel (Enigmas)

In the veil of mystery, where shadows play,
A dance unfolds in an eternal ballet.
Enigmas whisper, secrets to convey,
Echoes of time that echo today.

In the labyrinth of life, lost and found,
Through darkness we seek wisdom profound,
Mysteries unfold, their truth unbound,
A silent song in a world unsound.

In the silence of the night, secrets revealed,
As stars whisper tales that hearts do feel.
Enigmas dance, their story unsealed,
In the realm where heart and mind conceal.
